verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a consumer and business AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents exporting conversations, files, or account data in any format. The closest items are cross-device sync (grok-docs-41), cancelling a subscription (grok-docs-42) and server-side storage of prompts (grok-docs-21), which are adjacent features rather than an export capability.
